policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: V signs multi-flight joint development with United Semiconductors
items.summary: V announced a multi-flight joint development agreement for producing semiconductor materials in orbit. It said it has completed three missions with W-4 currently in orbit, plus a fifth launch in coming weeks and several more expected to return in 2026.

items.headline: O closes $122B round at $852B post-money valuation
items.summary: O said it closed a funding round with $122B in committed capital and a $852B post-money valuation. It also cited a revolving credit facility (~$4.7B) staying undrawn and pointed to enterprise revenue mix and usage growth.

items.headline: G raises $650M to scale AI inference cloud
items.summary: G announced $650M in new growth capital to expand its inference cloud, stating it operates 13 data centers and targets scaling toward ~200 MW by end of 2027. It also described growth metrics and leadership additions.
